principles: One request calls the explicitly selected provider/model only.
Do not silently route to a different model on failure.
Third-party repositories are linked as integration targets, not copied wholesale.
Review each repository's current license before copying source code.
A free framework does not make cloud compute, GPU inference, or hosted API quotas unlimited.

integrations.name: ai-agent-comparison
integrations.notes: Native compare mode already exists; use this repository as evaluation/reference material, not a runtime dependency.

integrations.name: CrewAI-Langgraph-Projects
integrations.notes: Study/import selected patterns after checking license; do not load its entire environment into the Render service.

integrations.name: crewAI-examples
integrations.notes: Optional framework examples; not required by the native compare/council/plan engine.

integrations.name: mcp-memory-service
integrations.notes: Connect only after deploying/configuring an MCP server and explicit storage/auth; no remote memory server is presumed.

integrations.name: full-stack-ai-agent-template
integrations.notes: Separate FastAPI/React app template; merge selected components manually after license and dependency review.

integrations.name: agentops
integrations.notes: Optional SDK; needs its own configuration/account and should be installed only when enabled.

integrations.name: CrewAI-Studio
integrations.notes: Separate Streamlit UI; current MADEX UI is served by static/index.html.

integrations.name: AgentsCrashCourse
integrations.notes: Educational repository, not a production runtime dependency.

integrations.name: innovation-lab-examples
integrations.notes: Protocol examples can inform a future A2A adapter; not auto-enabled.

integrations.name: academic-commercialization-agent
integrations.notes: Domain-specific application; not required for general chat gateway.

integrations.name: caspian-sdk
integrations.notes: Separate messaging SDK; requires channel credentials and explicit user configuration.

integrations.name: LibreChat
integrations.notes: Deploy as a separate Node/Docker service and point it at MADEX OpenAI-compatible endpoints; not bundled into the Python Render image.

integrations.name: big-AGI
integrations.notes: Separate frontend/service; configure its provider endpoint to MADEX where supported.

integrations.name: MetaGPT
integrations.notes: Large agent framework; resource-intensive and not suitable to install by default on a 512 MB free Render instance.

integrations.name: rea
integrations.notes: Separate specialized project; not automatically run against uploaded binaries.

integrations.name: awesome-multi-agent-papers
integrations.notes: Reference list only, not executable integration.

integrations.name: g4f
integrations.notes: Optional dependency; browser-based providers can fail or violate upstream terms. No guarantee of unlimited free access.

integrations.name: Open Interpreter
integrations.notes: Do not enable arbitrary code execution in the public API container; use an isolated local process with explicit user approval.

integrations.name: ComfyUI
integrations.notes: Run separately on a GPU-capable host and add a dedicated authenticated API adapter; not feasible inside free Render web dyno.

integrations.name: Fooocus
integrations.notes: Run separately on compatible GPU hardware; local model weights are large.

integrations.name: AUTOMATIC1111 WebUI
integrations.notes: Run separately with API enabled and secure the endpoint before connecting.

integrations.name: DuckDuckGo AI Chat
integrations.notes: No stable supported public chat API wired here; no scraping, cookie theft, or reverse-engineering. Use a supported search API instead.

integrations.name: LiteLLM
integrations.notes: Set LITELLM_BASE_URL, LITELLM_API_KEY, and LITELLM_MODELS for a proxy you control or are authorized to use.

integrations.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
integrations.notes: Set HF_TOKEN; free credits/availability vary by account and model.

integrations.name: Ollama
integrations.notes: Set OLLAMA_BASE_URL to a reachable server; optional OLLAMA_API_KEY is sent as a bearer token. Render localhost is not your phone/PC.

integrations.name: PawanOsman-compatible API
integrations.notes: Requires an authorized endpoint URL and any required key; service/model availability is not guaranteed.
